subject: Mutual Action Plan: ACME MAP & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Daniel Ortiz <dan.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: ACME MAP & Next Steps

Hi Sam / Priya / Daniel -

Thanks again for a productive call today. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have clear milestones, owners, and dates. Please review and reply with any edits; I will update the shared worksheet after we confirm.

Summary of pain & goals (what we heard today):
- High token costs and inconsistent latency on current hosted model endpoints - goal is to reduce per-request cost by ~40% while keeping 95th percentile latency under 300ms for typical queries.
- Need auditability and audit logs for the assistant behavior for compliance.
- Integration: embed search + reranking pipeline into their existing workflow (Sales Assist).

Proposed MAP (milestones, owners, dates):
1) Technical validation / POC scope (deliverable: runbook + test prompts) - Owner: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) - Target: 2027-05-19
2) Performance benchmarking (deliverable: perf report vs current infra) - Owner: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) - Target: 2027-05-26
3) Security/compliance review (deliverable: evidence pack & gap list) - Owner: Priya Shah (ACME) + Redwood Security - Target: 2027-06-02
4) Procurement & contract review (deliverable: signed MSA + SOW) - Owner: Daniel Ortiz (ACME) + Marissa Cole (Redwood) - Target: 2027-06-09
5) Pilot rollout (deliverable: pilot environment with 1k daily users) - Owner: ACME Engineering - Target: 2027-06-23

Key stakeholders (confirmed on call):
- ACME: Priya Shah (Head of Product), Daniel Ortiz (Procurement), Sam Carter (Eng Manager)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Rishi Malhotra (Solutions), Vivek Kulkarni (SRE)

Decision process and timeline:
- Final go/no-go at end of pilot (by 2027-06-30). Procurement prefers to complete contract by 2027-06-09 to meet internal fiscal approvals.

Open questions / blocker list:
- ACME to confirm which environments can be used for POC (staging vs prod data).
- Procurement requested a SOC2 summary and standard security answers (attached SOC2 extract).

Next steps (agreed on call):
- I will upload the MAP draft to the shared drive and assign owners - action: Marissa (today).
- Rishi to propose POC test plan - action: Rishi (by 2027-05-12).
- Vivek to schedule perf run and share baseline metrics - action: Vivek (by 2027-05-26).
- Priya / Daniel to loop in procurement and security contacts and confirm PO timeline - action: ACME (by 2027-05-12).

Attachments: ACME_MAP_Draft.xlsx (initial MAP), ACME_SOC2_Summary.pdf (security snapshot)

Thanks - looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

[Attachment: ACME_MAP_Draft.xlsx (Excel)]
[Attachment: ACME_SOC2_Summary.pdf (PDF)]
